# Change

Name the affected site/filter files and describe the affected placement and resulting
behavior. Link the issue if any.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run --locked python scripts/check.py` passes.
- [ ] For rule changes, checked the affected page with uBO and ordinary content that
  should remain visible.
- [ ] For rule changes, ran the relevant site suite with the shared Firefox verifier or
  explained why it could not run.
- [ ] Bumped the changed list's version and updated the changelog.

Describe results here. Keep generated artifacts out of the commit.
